---
title: "census city county lookup"
author: "Peter Franz"
date: "2026-11-20"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(here)

census_dir <- here("data", "census")

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
```

```{r geographic_matching}

# Load the saved nationwide city and county datasets
national_census_geo <- readRDS(
  file.path(census_dir, "national_census_geo_2024.rds")
)

national_counties_geo <- readRDS(
  file.path(census_dir, "national_counties_geo_2024.rds")
)

# Retrieve 2024 nationwide Census place boundaries
city_boundaries <- tigris::places(
  state = NULL,
  year = 2024,
  cb = TRUE
)

# Keep only places in our existing Census dataset
city_boundaries <- city_boundaries %>%
  filter(GEOID %in% national_census_geo$GEOID)

# Retrieve 2024 county boundaries
county_boundaries <- tigris::counties(
  year = 2024,
  cb = TRUE
)

# Keep only counties in our existing dataset
county_boundaries <- county_boundaries %>%
  filter(GEOID %in% national_counties_geo$GEOID)

# Keep essential identifiers and geometry
city_boundaries <- city_boundaries %>%
  select(
    city_geoid = GEOID,
    city_name = NAME,
    geometry
  )

county_boundaries <- county_boundaries %>%
  select(
    county_geoid = GEOID,
    county_name = NAME,
    geometry
  )

# Convert both datasets to the same projected CRS
city_boundaries <- st_transform(
  city_boundaries,
  crs = 6933
)

county_boundaries <- st_transform(
  county_boundaries,
  crs = 6933
)

# Check the resulting dimensions
dim(city_boundaries)

dim(county_boundaries)
```

```{r id_city_county_relationships}

# Find which county boundaries intersect each Census place
county_matches <- st_intersects(
  city_boundaries,
  county_boundaries
)

# Count the number of matching counties for each place
city_county_counts <- city_boundaries %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    county_count = lengths(county_matches),
    county_status = case_when(
      county_count == 0 ~ "No match",
      county_count == 1 ~ "Single county",
      county_count > 1 ~ "Multiple counties"
    )
  )

# Summarize the results
city_county_counts %>%
  count(county_status)

# Inspect places intersecting multiple counties
city_county_counts %>%
  filter(county_count > 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(county_count)) %>%
  head(20)
```

```{r city_county_overlaps}

# Identify counties whose interiors overlap each Census place
county_overlaps <- st_relate(
  city_boundaries,
  county_boundaries,
  pattern = "T********"
)

# Count overlapping counties for each Census place
city_county_refined <- city_boundaries %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    county_count = lengths(county_overlaps),
    county_status = case_when(
      county_count == 0 ~ "No match",
      county_count == 1 ~ "Single county",
      county_count > 1 ~ "Multiple counties"
    )
  )

# Summarize geographic relationships
city_county_refined %>%
  count(county_status)

# Inspect the same locations as before
city_county_refined %>%
  filter(
    city_geoid %in% c(
      "3651000",
      "4260000",
      "4055000",
      "4827000"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    city_geoid,
    city_name,
    county_count,
    county_status
  )
```
